The '''Cerean Reach''', also known as the '''Cerean Run''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that traveled out from [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. It reached as far [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] as the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region, where it linked up with [["The Loop" (hyperlane)|"The Loop"]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shuldene/Legends|Shuldene]].
